description: Do you know how to make a perfect pizza dough or pie crust? They can easily come out with a Remeel silicone rolling pin!
EASY TO USE AND CLEAN UP

You can not believe that it is SUPER easy to clean up and dry very quickly because of the silicone surface. Simply spray with a light coat of oil or sprinkle a bit of flour,even a kid can do it, with grip handle to roll dough.Compared to wooden or marble material, stuff will not stick to a silicone rolling pin.Unlike traditional wood, the silicone surface leaves no spaces for bacteria and mold to grow. It makes you a happy baking day!

Roll pastry, bread and cookie dough more easily than ever before with these easy-to-sanitize Silicone Rolling Pins. Flatten meats and breads, crush crackers and nuts. Beyond the kitchen, roll clay, candle wax or homemade paper; apply creative paint effects; or even use these rolling pins for a back or foot massage. The easily cleaned silicone can withstand boiling water for complete sterilization, if needed. Use them in ways you never imagined.
